title: Account Executive Product - Tax
description:
Who we are
 About Stripe
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
 About the team
 Product Sales is a team of functional and technical specialists who both lead and advise on deals for the most strategically important products in Stripe’s portfolio. Revenue suite Product Sales is tasked with attacking a $100B market opportunity for back office finance automation across billing, tax, revenue reporting, and data.
 What you’ll do
 We are seeking a dynamic and motivated Senior Account Executive to join our growing Tax Product Sales team in Singapore. In this role, you will be responsible for selling and driving revenue for Stripe Tax in APAC region, which helps businesses easily comply with indirect tax laws by calculating, collecting and filing their taxes allowing them to grow anywhere they have demand. You will collaborate with prospects and customers to understand their compliance and business needs and offer tailored solutions that help businesses grow as they expand to new markets. You will help define how we go to market, our key sales messaging, and work with some of the largest users at Stripe.
 Responsibilities
 As a seller, you’ll be accountable for driving revenue, increasing attach rates, and new client acquisition for Stripe Tax to a variety of businesses.
 Lead discussions with our largest existing and prospective customers across APAC region (mainly Southeast Asia, Greater China, Australia, and New Zealand)

title: Product Manager (DevTools & AI Reliability, remote)
description:
(Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3)
 The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken.
 They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.
 Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. Now we need a PM who wants to take that further, in a market being rewritten in real time.
 Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. Nobody has really figured out what reliability means for this kind of software yet. That's the problem you'd own.
 What you'll do As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for empowering developers and designers to solve customer problems. You will work directly with our SVP Product Engineering Daniel .
 You will:
 Shape company and product strategy alongside our SVP of Product Engineering. It's a genuine partnership: you'll develop the vision for where Checkly goes next, decide where we play in the AI testing, monitoring, and observability landscape and where we don't, and turn that into a direction. You build the strategy with us, not execute someone else's.
 Shape Checkly's point of view on reliability in an AI-native world: how teams monitor AI-generated code,…

title: IT Cloud Administrator (f/m/d)
description:

 - Entrepreneurial Spirit : We embrace change, think big, and push limits with passion.

Acting as the vital bridge between business requirements and technical execution, you will master the configuration of existing solutions and be the technical lead for new application/service implementations.
